title: Virtual-table instance and transaction finalizer wrappers

scope.rationale: Typed lifecycle helpers now expose connection-state instance lookup, the capacity-reserved transaction append primitive, and exact commit/rollback finalizer wrappers used by virtual-table create and begin paths.
excluded_responsibilities: Public SQL transaction integration for writable application virtual tables

external_source_responsibilities: Typed virtual table State, Table, Instance, Module, and callFinalizer owners
dependencies.caller_closure: Create/begin use addVirtualTransaction; public typed lifecycle clients use lookup and finalizer wrappers.

inputs: Lifecycle state, table, module set, and finalizer kind
outputs: Connection-owned instance lookup, retained transaction entry, or cleared transaction list
contracts.ownership: Appending increments the instance reference; finalization invokes the selected callback, resets state, decrements the reference, and clears entries.
contracts.state_and_results: Lookup returns only an instance attached to the requested state. Commit and rollback are infallible wrappers returning source-success semantics.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Calls module callbacks only through the typed lifecycle module table.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Capacity reservation occurs before append; finalizer callback result is intentionally ignored like source callFinaliser.

representation_differences: Connection ownership is represented by membership in typed lifecycle State.tables instead of linked VTable.db pointers.

oracle.protocol: Construct typed module/table instances, append transactions, run commit and rollback, and compare callback order, references, savepoint reset, and list clearing.

assurance.oom: Append is called only after successful five-slot capacity growth.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No direct I/O; lifecycle state serializes connection-local mutation.
assurance.malformed_input: Absent tables and instances return null or skip callbacks.
assurance.continuation: Finalizers always clear transaction state and permit subsequent transactions.

independent_review.notes: SQL transaction integration, trace, assurance, and review remain open.

known_blockers: Connect writable virtual tables to public SQL transaction completion.
Add focused trace and independent review.

implementation_spans: Complete source instance lookup, addToVTrans, callFinaliser, commit, and rollback region
Typed constructor, begin, and finalizer callers
assertions_branches_cleanup: missing instance, capacity, reference increment/decrement, callback absence, savepoint reset, and list clear reviewed
